artificial-neural-networks--hebb-s-law.note: Supervised rules carry a target t; Hebb, instar and competitive rules are driven by the input or by co-activation instead.

artificial-neural-networks--radial-basis.note: Once centres and widths are fixed, the output layer is linear in its weights, so training is one least-squares solve rather than gradient descent.

python-programming--re-search.title: searching anywhere in a string
python-programming--re-search.note: re.search scans the whole string; the match object exposes the matched text and its starting offset.

python-programming--slicing.note: start is inclusive, stop is exclusive, and a step of -1 walks the sequence backwards.

python-programming--try-except.title: catching ValueError
python-programming--try-except.note: int() raises ValueError for non-numeric text; the except clause catches that type instead of crashing.

python-programming--tuple.title: ordering and mutability of built-in collections
python-programming--tuple.note: Only the container is frozen: a tuple holding a list still exposes that list's mutations.

python-programming--variable.title: a name can be rebound to another type

python-programming--with-statement.title: context manager closes the file
python-programming--with-statement.note: The with block closes the file when it exits, even if the write raises an exception.

vlsi-physical-design--asic.title: ASIC implementation styles
vlsi-physical-design--asic.note: Moving down the table trades silicon efficiency for fewer custom masks and a shorter path to first silicon.

vlsi-physical-design--electromigration.title: Black's equation as a width rule
vlsi-physical-design--electromigration.note: Because n is about 2, halving the current density buys roughly four times the wire life; that exponent is the whole basis of the EM width rule.

vlsi-physical-design--pvt-corner.title: timing corners
vlsi-physical-design--pvt-corner.note: Setup is signed off slow-slow and hold fast-fast, so the two ends of the same die are both covered by one analysis.

vlsi-physical-design--static-timing-anal.title: the SDC that STA actually reads
vlsi-physical-design--static-timing-anal.note: STA needs no vectors: the clock, the port delays and the exceptions fully define every arrival and required time.

vlsi-physical-design--timing-constraints.title: from slack to the setup and hold inequalities
vlsi-physical-design--timing-constraints.note: Setup squeezes the period; hold does not contain T_clk, which is why it is fixed by adding delay rather than by slowing the clock.

vlsi-physical-design--timing-path.title: the four STA path types
vlsi-physical-design--timing-path.note: Every path in the design is one of these four; the launch and capture points decide which clock period applies.

vlsi-physical-design--via.title: metal stack and via transitions
vlsi-physical-design--via.note: Each via is a cut plus an enclosure on both layers; alternating directions let adjacent layers cross without parallel-run coupling.

vlsi-technology-and-design--cmos-inverte.title: switching threshold from equal drain currents
vlsi-technology-and-design--cmos-inverte.note: Equal strengths put the trip point halfway; widening the NMOS pulls V_M down and makes the gate harder to switch low.

vlsi-technology-and-design--lambda-based.title: classic 2λ layout rules
vlsi-technology-and-design--lambda-based.note: Every dimension is a multiple of λ = L_min/2, so one rule set survives a process shrink; the foundry deck is the final authority.

vlsi-technology-and-design--non-blocking.note: With <= the two flops form a shift register; with = they collapse into one stage, and r2 simply follows d.

vlsi-technology-and-design--oxidation.note: Thin oxides are reaction-limited and grow linearly; thick ones are diffusion-limited and grow as √t, so the same furnace gives both regimes.

vlsi-technology-and-design--verilog-valu.note: x propagates through arithmetic, so one uninitialised register can contaminate an otherwise valid simulation.
